reason: A web UI plugin that processes local DSH session usage logs to calculate, store, and display token consumption, cache statistics, and estimated costs with configurable model pricing.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中统计并展示对话的 Token 用量、缓存命中率和费用明细，支持汇总分析及自定义模型价格。
summaries.en: A DSH Web UI plugin that tracks and displays token usage, cache-hit statistics, and cost details with summaries and customizable model pricing.

capabilities: Reads local DSH session logs and usage events
Aggregates token, cache, model, session, date, and cost statistics
Writes a local ledger cache and custom model price configuration
Displays cost summaries and per-request details in the web UI
